title: Avatar
description: A paraplegic marine explores Pandora, falls in love, and becomes involved in a battle between humans and the Na'vi.

title: The Avengers
description: Earth's mightiest heroes unite to stop a powerful alien threat and protect the world from destruction.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: A group of misfit space adventurers must stop a powerful villain and protect the galaxy.

title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
description: A scavenger, a pilot, and a mysterious force user join a rebellion against a tyrannical empire.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief steals secrets by entering dreams and must plant an idea in someone's mind.

title: The Matrix
description: A hacker discovers that reality is an artificial simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines.

title: Dune
description: A young nobleman becomes entangled in a conflict over a desert planet and the spice that powers the universe.

title: Titanic
description: A young artist falls in love aboard a doomed ocean liner while facing social class barriers.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman confronts the Joker in a battle that tests justice, chaos, and morality in Gotham City.
